title: Stepped cantilever shaft under three torques: angle of twist

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: Gere and Timoshenko, Mechanics of Materials, 2nd ed., p. 171, problem 3.3-1 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Shaft along global X, built in at x = 0, three segments of 500 mm with solid circular sections of 80, 60 and 40 mm diameter (J = pi d^4 / 32), G = 80 kN/mm^2 (E = 200 kN/mm^2, nu = 0.25). Torques about the axis at the ends of the segments: 3000, 2000 and 800 kN mm - the units of the page's input listing and of its own arithmetic (0.0090 + 0.0138 + 0.0199 rad); the page's text says N mm, which is inconsistent with its result. Units kN, mm. First-order analysis (uniform torsion). Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
